data.body: RCA/fix: _check_home_escape treated any argv Name/Attribute called home, mkdtemp, or TemporaryDirectory as a home escape, so unrelated locals and tmp_path-rooted temp helpers could false-positive. Fixed in Gerrit 2953 by detecting only concrete Path.home() and os.environ['HOME']/imported environ['HOME'] AST forms. Also replaced the conftest source-grep UsageError check with behavioral assertion and pinned module-level helper opt-out fallback. RED evidence: new focused guard tests failed before the implementation. Verification: tests/unit/test_collection_isolation_guard.py passed; full make verify passed with PYTEST_WORKERS=2 and GIT_CONFIG_* unset; Gerrit 2953 passed LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1 and is merged.
